name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
description: Create, edit, save, and roll Call of Cthulhu 7th edition investigator sheets in a native ChatGPT plugin view.

interface.longDescription: A standalone investigator library inspired by Quest Portal's Enhanced Call of Cthulhu Sheet. Manage characteristics, skills, health, sanity, luck, weapons, backstory and possessions. Roll percentile checks with bonus and penalty dice, import and export JSON, and explicitly share a sheet with ChatGPT. Includes sidebar and conversation panel entrypoints. Private saved investigator libraries; no Quest Portal account required.
defaultPrompt: Open my Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets.
Help me create a Call of Cthulhu investigator.
